ODGS: 3D Scene Reconstruction from OmniDirectional Images with 3D Gaussian Splatting 

**NeurIPS 2024** 
[Suyoung Lee](https://esw0116.github.io/)1\*,  [Jaeyoung Chung](https://robot0321.github.io/)1\*,  Jaeyoo Huh2,  [Kyoung Mu Lee](https://cv.snu.ac.kr/index.php/~kmlee/)1,2, 
\*Denotes Equal Contribution 


1,2 Computer Vision Lab, Seoul National University   
[![](https://robot0321.github.io/imgs/logo_cvlab.png) ](https://cv.snu.ac.kr/) 
[**  Paper ](https://neurips.cc/virtual/2024/poster/96122)    [  **  ArXiv ](https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.20686)    [  **  Poster ](https://robot0321.github.io/odgs/imgs/odgs_poster.jpg)    [  **  Slides ](https://robot0321.github.io/odgs/imgs/odgs_slides.pdf)    [  **  Code ](https://github.com/esw0116/ODGS)  

**TL;DR.** Designing 3DGS rasterizer for omnidirectional image, implemented in CUDA, verifed mathematically. 

![method](https://robot0321.github.io/odgs/imgs/method.jpg) 

**Illustration on rasterization process of ODGS.** We describe the process of projecting a 3D Gaussian to the omnidirectional pixel space. \(a\) Transforming the coordinate from the original to target. \(b\) Projecting Gaussians onto the tangent plane. \(c\) Compensating equirectangular space stretch. \(d\) Scaling to pixel space and blending with other Gaussians. 


## Abstract

Omnidirectional \(or 360\-degree\) images are increasingly being used for 3D applications since they allow the rendering of an entire scene with a single image. Existing works based on neural radiance fields demonstrate successful 3D reconstruction quality on egocentric videos, yet they suffer from long training and rendering times. Recently, 3D Gaussian splatting has gained attention for its fast optimization and real\-time rendering. However, directly using a perspective rasterizer to omnidirectional images results in severe distortion due to the different optical properties between two image domains. In this work, we present ODGS, a novel rasterization pipeline for omnidirectional images, with geometric interpretation. For each Gaussian, we define a tangent plane that touches the unit sphere and is perpendicular to the ray headed toward the Gaussian center. We then leverage a perspective camera rasterizer to project the Gaussian onto the corresponding tangent plane. The projected Gaussians are transformed and combined into the omnidirectional image, finalizing the omnidirectional rasterization process. This interpretation reveals the implicit assumptions within the proposed pipeline, which we verify through mathematical proofs. The entire rasterization process is parallelized using CUDA, achieving optimization and rendering speeds 100 times faster than NeRF\-based methods. Our comprehensive experiments highlight the superiority of ODGS by delivering the best reconstruction and perceptual quality across various datasets. Additionally, results on roaming datasets demonstrate that ODGS restores fine details effectively, even when reconstructing large 3D scenes. The source code is available on our project page. 

### Qualitative Results
![indoor compare](https://robot0321.github.io/odgs/imgs/odgs_qual1.jpg) 
![indoor compare](https://robot0321.github.io/odgs/imgs/odgs_qual2.jpg)

# 全景视频首版 / Panorama video v1
[Permalink: 全景视频首版 / Panorama video v1](https://github.com/ooolabdev/ooosplat/blob/main/docs/PANORAMA_VIDEO_V1.md#%E5%85%A8%E6%99%AF%E8%A7%86%E9%A2%91%E9%A6%96%E7%89%88--panorama-video-v1)

开发分支 `feat/panorama\-video\-v1`；不是新版本发布声明。

## 输入和使用
[Permalink: 输入和使用](https://github.com/ooolabdev/ooosplat/blob/main/docs/PANORAMA_VIDEO_V1.md#%E8%BE%93%E5%85%A5%E5%92%8C%E4%BD%BF%E7%94%A8)

仅支持 FFmpeg 可解码、已拼接、单目、完整 360°×180°、2:1 等距柱状（ERP）的 MP4。不按相机品牌设白名单；不支持双鱼眼、双目、VR180、裁切全景或厂商私有原片。请先使用厂商软件导出标准单目 ERP。

素材输入框与下方识别状态共用边框和一条内部横线。空态显示“请输入视频文件或图片文件夹”，选择视频后显示“正在检测视频类型…”；检测失败可在框内重试。有完整 ERP 元数据且符合支持条件时自动使用全景流程，显示“全景视频”和“已识别完整 ERP 元数据，将自动按全景视频生成”。普通视频显示“将按普通视频处理”。仅有 2:1 尺寸时，在素材框内选择“普通视频／全景视频”，不预选；未选择不能开始生成。手动选择全景不冒称检测到了 ERP 元数据，选择仍可修改。不再提供视频预览或生成后的投影确认弹窗。2:1 普通视频仍可走普通流程，已知不支持的投影不能选择全景。球面 yaw/pitch/roll 只是全局观察方向，不改变完整 ERP 的局部射线；SfM 使用自身世界坐标，不因品牌的观察方向元数据而拒绝。FFmpeg 的 180° 显示旋转仍是完整 ERP；90°/270° 会改变横纵布局，需先规范化导出。

生成前的统一多步检查仅保留图片数量提醒，支持返回、取消和键盘操作；视频类型不再进入弹窗。自动队列开启前需所有有素材的待命任务检测完成、疑似视频均已选择类型，否则保持关闭并定位第一个需处理的任务。开启后新素材检测期间不自动启动后续任务；发现待选择或检测失败的素材时关闭队列，不影响当前运行任务、不跳过该任务，用户处理后需手动重新开启。开启开关本身不启动第一个任务。选择按草稿和素材身份保存在本机；路径、大小或修改时间变化后失效，后端启动前再次校验。

已完成／未完成详情采用同一只读素材框，统一显示“本任务按全景视频处理／本任务按普通视频处理／本任务按图片序列处理”。类型由已有检查点返回的可选 `ProjectTaskDetail.videoProjection` 提供，不重新检测原文件；确实未记录时明确显示未知，导入 Gaussian 项目不显示不适用的视频信息。不修改项目 schema。

训练节点区分“准备训练图片”和实际 Brush 训练。前者显示原全景帧及六面图片真实计数，缓存复用单独写日志，校验完成前不结束；全景总进度分配 60%–66% 给准备、66%–98% 给训练，普通任务保持原映射。未知总量显示处理中，不估造百分比；训练步数和剩余时间仅使用 Brush 的真实数据，切换子阶段清除旧计数。事件的可选 `substage` 用于本机界面，不新增云端统计字段或永久项目阶段。

CLI 示例（指定诊断目录时不会登记到应用列表，也不发送埋点）：

```
cargo run --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --bin splatstudio -- generate "D:/video/stitched-360.mp4" --projects-root "D:/diagnostic-projects" --quality fast --video-projection equirectangular
```

`\-\-video\-projection` 支持 `auto / perspective / equirectangular`。普通视频流程、已有项目检查点和普通补拍不变。全景项目首版暂不开放高清补拍。

## 实际处理流程
[Permalink: 实际处理流程](https://github.com/ooolabdev/ooosplat/blob/main/docs/PANORAMA_VIDEO_V1.md#%E5%AE%9E%E9%99%85%E5%A4%84%E7%90%86%E6%B5%81%E7%A8%8B)
1. FFprobe 检查投影、立体布局、尺寸及旋转。全景抽帧另行流式读取解码帧索引、原始 PTS 和真实时间，不使用平均 FPS 推算时间戳；最多 100 万帧，时间探测输出只保留 4 KiB 诊断尾部。 
2. 复用档位初始采样和 Bridge 候选预算，以原全景时刻为选择单位。保存整幅 ERP，而非六面图；Alpha 图和 Mask 保持现有语义。 
3. COLMAP 模型 17 `EQUIRECTANGULAR`，参数为 **width,height**，不是焦距。顺序匹配与 Incremental Mapper；局部、全局 BA 显式 `CERES`，包括 Bridge 重建，完全绕过 Caspar。全景专用初始化三角化角度 1°，允许任意方向平移；普通透视参数不变。 
4. 保留 `work/colmap/` 球面结果为权威重建。只有最终注册的 ERP 帧转换成 front/back/left/right/up/down 六面；不再匹配或重跑 SfM。 
5. 派生 `work/panorama\-training/`：六面共享中心，`R\_face = Q R\_erp`、`t\_face = Q t\_erp`。相机 x 向右、y 向下、z 向前，像素中心 `\(x\+0.5,y\+0.5\)`，主点 `\(N/2,N/2\)`，`f=N/\(2 tan\(46°\)\)`。RGB 双线性采样、Mask 最近邻采样共享映射；ERP 左右取模环绕、两极钳制。 
6. 六面共享 PINHOLE 相机。初始化三维点的位置、颜色、尺度保持不变；新图像 ID 从 1 编号，二维观测和旧 ERP 轨迹清空，避免悬空引用。

## English summary
[Permalink: English summary](https://github.com/ooolabdev/ooosplat/blob/main/docs/PANORAMA_VIDEO_V1.md#english-summary)

The monitoring fix uses optional operation identities and actual process\-execution counts. Only lifecycle events change phases; logs, heartbeats and resource samples cannot clear or resurrect runtime state. Matching substeps and registered\-image counts are not stage\-completion percentages. Unknown stage progress is shown as Processing. The Splat training node keeps its name throughout face preparation, validation and training, using one combined stage range. The overall header shows only a percentage, retaining the latest valid value within each task/run and staying below 100% until successful completion; the backend estimate semantics are unchanged.

The caption/log follow\-up passed 416 frontend, 6 diagnostic and 365 regular Rust tests, build, formatting and Clippy. Nine resource\-dependent tests are opt\-in and two existing symlink tests were explicitly excluded for missing fixture\-creation privileges. Separate replay retained all 86 real matching\-index lines without inventing a stage percentage. Matching silence notices start after 15 seconds, repeat at most every 30 seconds, reset on output and stop on exit/cancellation. Chinese/English replay of 2,464 previously captured native events recorded zero monitor remounts, incorrect training\-node labels or premature 100%. No new generation/training run or native WebView2 manual acceptance was performed for this follow\-up.

A fresh real Fast pipeline on a 3840×1920, 14.38\-second ERP MP4 registered 86/86 source frames and produced 516 faces, 16,757 sparse points, 240,002 Gaussians and a 56,642,087\-byte PLY after 8,000 steps \(342.95 seconds\). Chinese/English Edge replay of all 2,464 native events recorded zero monitor\-container remounts, incorrect training\-node labels or premature 100%. This does not replace manual native Windows WebView2 acceptance. The 379 frontend tests, 6 diagnostic tests, build, formatting, Clippy and 357 regular Rust tests passed; two existing symlink tests were explicitly excluded because this environment cannot create their fixtures, and seven resource\-dependent tests are opt\-in.

The separate real cancellation/resume test also passed \(223.91 seconds, 86 ERP frames, 235,723 Gaussians\), preserving the authoritative spherical model and completed face batches, including modification times. Its events are stored in `.cache/panorama\-v1/last\-resume\-events.json`.

Development\-only v1 supports **stitched, monoscopic, full 360×180, 2:1 ERP MP4**. The media picker and its detection status form a single connected box, including an empty prompt, loading state and retry on failure. Confirmed metadata selects panorama automatically. A 2:1 ratio alone never enables panorama: the user must choose ordinary video or full panorama inline before Generate becomes available. Manual selection remains editable and does not claim ERP metadata was detected. There is no video preview or video\-type dialog; the extensible preflight remains for image\-count warnings. Automatic execution requires every populated standby draft to finish analysis and resolve its type; new unresolved input disables the queue without interrupting the active task or skipping ahead. Users must re\-enable it after correction. Choices are stored per draft and source identity, invalidated by path/size/modification changes and checked again before launch. Historical media boxes show the saved processing type without probing source files, using the optional `ProjectTaskDetail.videoProjection` response field without a project\-schema change. Stereo, dual\-fisheye, VR180, cropped/private formats and quarter\-turn layouts cannot enter ERP generation. Static spherical viewing orientation is a global gauge, not a reason to reject standard ERP.

Panorama training preparation reports real panorama/face counts and verified cache reuse, occupies 60–66% overall, and completes only after camera/data validation. Actual Brush training occupies 66–98% and reports real iterations; ordinary progress mapping is unchanged. Unknown totals remain indeterminate, stale counters/ETA are cleared at substage changes, and no cloud telemetry fields or permanent project stages are added.

Whole ERP frames enter SfM with actual decoder indices/PTS/times, camera 17 \(`width,height`\), sequential matching and Incremental Mapper. Local/global BA explicitly use Ceres, including Bridge. Only registered frames become six co\-centered 92° PINHOLE views, with correctly composed rotations **and translations**. RGB/masks share wrap\-aware projection. Original sphere models remain authoritative; derived images have fresh IDs, empty observations and no stale ERP tracks; world\-space initialization points remain unchanged.

Fast/Balanced/High: ERP width caps 2048/3072/4096, face caps 512/768/1024 without upsampling. Sequential conversion resumes in complete batches. Original Brush steps/densification remain; image cache is 2 GiB. No sixfold step multiplication, GPU projection or panorama reshoots. Draft choices survive restarts; older checkpoints remain perspective.

Windows acceptance used a 9.4\-second MP4 synthesized from 94 actual Ballintoy ERP photographs, not supplied poses. CPU smoke: 38/38 registered. Full Fast: 56/56 registered, 7,987 points, 336 faces, 8,000 steps, 209,467 Gaussians, 49,435,829\-byte PLY. Native\-brand MP4/VFR metadata, native alpha video, long\-resource stress, macOS/Linux engines, Balanced/High quality and direction tuning remain separate acceptance work. Unit/mock passes are not claims of visual quality.

2026\-10\-18 follow\-up: 354 frontend, 6 diagnostic receiver and 355 Rust tests passed \(5 existing opt\-in tests excluded by default\), as did the build, formatting, all\-target/all\-feature Clippy, resource and license checks. Real Ballintoy acceptance for this change resumes a saved spherical checkpoint and exercises face preparation, cancellation/reuse and Brush training; it is not a fresh SfM run. The real dialog component/styles were screenshot\-checked in isolated Edge with a Ballintoy preview; full manual Windows WebView2 interaction remains unverified.

Final native acceptance took 150.33 seconds: 56 ERP frames, 336 faces, 8,000 steps and 223,553 Gaussians. The authoritative sphere model and completed cache batches were unchanged. Captured events verify separate preparation/training ranges, real counts, monotonic overall progress and no 100% before completion. Gaussian counts vary with training randomness.

The later inline\-picker revision passed 367 frontend, 6 diagnostic and 356 Rust tests, build, formatting, Clippy, resource and license checks. A separately executed read\-only real\-input test confirmed 3840×1920 ERP metadata, empty preview bytes and saved panorama processing from an existing project. No user project was regenerated. Isolated Edge checks of Chinese/English, a 320px media panel and 125% interface scaling found zero gaps and no horizontal overflow. Full native Tauri manual interaction remains unverified.

# 全景图片与快速素材检测
[Permalink: 全景图片与快速素材检测](https://github.com/ooolabdev/ooosplat/blob/main/docs/PANORAMA_IMAGES_V1.md#%E5%85%A8%E6%99%AF%E5%9B%BE%E7%89%87%E4%B8%8E%E5%BF%AB%E9%80%9F%E7%B4%A0%E6%9D%90%E6%A3%80%E6%B5%8B)

分支：`feat/panorama\-video\-v1`。这是开发分支说明，不表示已发布到 0.6.1 安装包。沿用现有图片文件夹入口；不支持单张生成、双鱼眼拼接、双目、VR180、裁切全景或私有原片。

## 输入与检测
[Permalink: 输入与检测](https://github.com/ooolabdev/ooosplat/blob/main/docs/PANORAMA_IMAGES_V1.md#%E8%BE%93%E5%85%A5%E4%B8%8E%E6%A3%80%E6%B5%8B)
- 至少两张 JPG/JPEG/PNG，按文件名自然排序，EXIF 方向归一后的尺寸一致。ERP 必须完整、单目、2:1。 
- 同时最多四个文件头读取器。JPEG APP1、PNG eXIf/iTXt 中的 EXIF/XMP 共享每文件 64 KiB 预算，压缩 iTXt 解压输出也计入预算；跳过像素载荷。XML 不展开 DTD/外部实体。缺失、冲突、截断或超限元数据不自动确认为 ERP。 
- 按 [GPano 规范](https://developers.google.com/streetview/spherical-metadata)核对投影、全幅和裁切尺寸、零裁切偏移。全部图片一致、可验证且符合尺寸要求才自动确认；仅 2:1 要求选择。已知非 ERP、立体和裁切证据禁止启用全景。 
- 快速检测不是完整的可解码性校验：损坏的像素载荷可能在准备阶段报错。生成阶段通过实际解码器重新校验 EXIF；无法与已检测尺寸安全对齐的素材拒绝处理，不静默使用错误方向。 
- 视频基础信息与投影共用一次 FFprobe 元数据调用，无 `\-count\_frames`、`\-show\_frames` 或 FFmpeg 预览提取。真实视频时间戳仍在生成阶段读取。 
- `analyze\_input` 先返回轻量结果，`probe\_and\_plan` 后续规划与硬件检查；选择框不等待硬件结果。后端有容量八项的单飞缓存；草稿已有分析也沿用旧视频接口的身份校验契约，缓存淘汰后仍可重规划，新增覆盖超过八份草稿的测试。质量/自动优化变化只规划，不重复头读取或 FFprobe。 
- 文件夹身份覆盖规范化目录路径及自然排序后的成员名、大小和修改时间；视频沿用路径、大小和修改时间。重启重新验证身份，前端用草稿修订和路径隔离迟到响应；素材变化清除旧答案。 
- 自动队列对图片和视频应用相同屏障：检测中不启动后续任务，未选择不跳过；疑似新素材关闭队列，选择后需手动重新开启。 

## 处理路径与初值
[Permalink: 处理路径与初值](https://github.com/ooolabdev/ooosplat/blob/main/docs/PANORAMA_IMAGES_V1.md#%E5%A4%84%E7%90%86%E8%B7%AF%E5%BE%84%E4%B8%8E%E5%88%9D%E5%80%BC)

| 档位 |  ERP 宽度上限 |  六面单面上限 |  视场 | 
|---|---|---|---|
| 快速 |  2048 |  512 |  92° | 
| 均衡 |  3072 |  768 |  92° | 
| 精细 |  4096 |  1024 |  92° | 

不放大源图；ERP 高度为宽度的一半，面尺寸不超过 ERP 宽度的四分之一。全部输入图片参与准备，不使用视频 FPS、采样比例或 Bridge 候选。
1. 图片导入保持原始字节，记录 `source/image\-origins.json` 中原路径、大小、修改时间与项目副本名；不改写外部原图。 
2. 生成时计算源内容 SHA\-256，与 EXIF 方向、准备文件名、档位组成检查点。派生图片规范化 EXIF、等比缩小；RGBA、COLMAP 图片和二值 Alpha Mask 像素对齐。COLMAP Mask 名为完整图片名追加 `.png`。 
3. COLMAP 使用共享模型17 `EQUIRECTANGULAR`，参数 width,height；图片默认穷举匹配，超过100张时生成前确认顺序，已按拍摄顺序排列则使用顺序匹配（重叠窗口10），否则仍为穷举匹配。顺序匹配在自动优化开启时沿用档位闭环检测规则。策略保存在任务请求和项目检查点，续跑不重新询问，旧项目缺少记录时仍为穷举匹配；不要求未排序素材伪装成有序。Incremental Mapper、显式局部/全局 Ceres BA、现有 1° 初始化配置不变，不启用 Caspar。 
4. 球面重建保留为权威结果。仅已注册图片进入现有六面缓存；同步转换 `R\_face = Q R\_erp`、`t\_face = Q t\_erp`，不再匹配或重建。RGB/Alpha 与 Mask 共用环绕映射，Mask 最近邻。 
5. 三维初始化点坐标和颜色保持不变，旧 ERP 二维观测与轨迹清空。使用下述全景专用 Brush 配方，不把步数乘六；普通素材配方不变。 
6. `manifest.json` 的 `config.imageSources` 连接原文件身份、项目副本、方向和准备图片；每面连接注册图像/相机。图片面没有 PTS 或时间戳字段；旧视频清单缺少 imageSources 时仍按视频解释。 
7. 图片参考视角取自然顺序中最早已注册图片的 front 面；历史详情读取可选通用 `inputProjection`，保留旧 `videoProjection`。预览、编辑、定位与导出复用现有流程。 

单图解码仍限 512 MiB，不代表整个进程峰值内存。2026\-10\-21 起，准备副本、Mask 与六面缓存不再受固定 20 GiB 门槛限制；保留尺寸、数量与整数溢出检查，不按缓存估算拒绝或减少图片。逐张处理并在发布前校验；取消/失败清理本次临时目录，不将不完整准备结果写入检查点，请预留足够磁盘空间。源内容或配置变化失效图片、特征、匹配、重建和训练；断点复用先校验准备文件和缓存。图片的训练 Alpha 保持连续值，SfM 的二值阈值 Mask 不再截掉低透明度训练区域。

## 全景训练配方 v1
[Permalink: 全景训练配方 v1](https://github.com/ooolabdev/ooosplat/blob/main/docs/PANORAMA_IMAGES_V1.md#%E5%85%A8%E6%99%AF%E8%AE%AD%E7%BB%83%E9%85%8D%E6%96%B9-v1)

本节同时适用于全景视频和全景图片。`config/pipeline\-optimization.json` 的可选 `panoramaTraining` 配置独立于普通素材；旧外部配置缺少此字段时使用本节默认值。项目 schema 和旧任务已保存的 Brush 参数不改写。

|---|---|---|---|
| 关闭自动优化的点数上限 |  1,000,000 |  2,000,000 |  3,000,000 |

With Auto Optimize off, panorama\-only recipes cap splats at 1M / 2M / 3M; with it on, tier ceilings remain 1M / 5M / 10M, further restricted by VRAM. Growth starts at zero; SH degree remains 3. ERP/face resolution caps, 92° FOV and ordinary recipes are unchanged.

Auto Optimize uses Fast / Balanced / High caps of 1/1/1M for unknown or <8 GiB, 1/2/3M for 8–<12 GiB, 1/3/5M for 12–<16 GiB, 1/5/7.5M for 16–<24 GiB and 1/5/10M for ≥24 GiB. These budgets are not memory guarantees. Initial points can raise the effective cap, but never past 10M. Exactly one OOM retry may halve the cap without dropping initial points; all other parameters are preserved. With optimization off, use the separate 1/2/3M caps and do not retry automatically. Older configurations missing the new off\-mode fields use the current manual defaults. Snapshots retain the actual recipe across cancellation/resume; existing snapshots keep their old recipes.

The diagnostic reads an existing cache, writes only a fresh `.cache` output, and records real growth and memory samples. Whole\-GPU usage is not isolated training VRAM. Cached 512px faces do not validate full\-resolution High quality, and reaching 5M requires a successfully completed real export, not a mathematical growth estimate.

## English summary
[Permalink: English summary](https://github.com/ooolabdev/ooosplat/blob/main/docs/PANORAMA_IMAGES_V1.md#english-summary)

Folders accept two or more same\-sized stitched monoscopic full ERP JPG/JPEG/PNG images. Header\-only detection uses a four\-reader limit and a 64 KiB per\-file metadata budget including decompression. Complete consistent GPano metadata auto\-confirms ERP; ambiguous inputs require an inline choice. Explicit incompatible metadata cannot be overridden. A single FFprobe supplies video metadata, and replanning reuses cached detection.

Image preparation normalizes EXIF into derived files, preserves RGB/Alpha/Mask alignment, and processes all images without FPS or Bridge sampling. Ordinary and panorama image tasks with more than 100 images ask whether filename order follows capture order before starting. Ordered sets use sequential matching \(overlap 10, preset loop detection only with automatic optimization\); unordered sets and sets of up to 100 images use exhaustive matching. No answer is preselected. Queue execution waits for the answer; cancellation disables the queue without skipping the task. The strategy is saved with the task and project checkpoint; resumes retain it and legacy projects default to exhaustive matching. Spherical COLMAP retains explicit Ceres BA; registered images alone produce existing 92° pinhole faces. Brush training settings are unchanged. Source identities and face mappings are persisted without invented video timestamps. The first naturally ordered registered image's front face supplies the reference view. Existing videos/projects remain compatible; panorama reshoots stay disabled.
